blocks.text: Viscosity samajhne ke liye ek beaker mein pani lein, use sheeshe ki rod se hilayein aur kuch der chhor dein. Pani ka ghoomna thori der mein tham jata hai. Ghaur se dekhein: beaker ki deewaron ke saath wali liquid ki tah (layer) sab se pehle rukti hai aur beech (centre) wali tah sab se aakhir mein. Matlab deewar ke saath ruki hui tah apne saath lagi tah ko foran aahista karti hai; yeh aahista tah agli andar wali tah ko bhi aahista karti hai, magar kam. Yani liquid ki aahista chalne wali tah apne saath wali tez tah ko aahista karti hai. Saath saath wali tahon ke darmiyan yeh ek ragar (friction) wali force hai.

blocks.title: Viscosity
blocks.text: Liquid ke behne (flow) ke khilaf is rukawat (resistance) ko viscosity kehte hain.
SI system mein viscosity ki unit kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ hai. CGS system mein is ki unit poise (P) hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Shehad (honey) aur pani dono ko ulta karein: shehad aahista behta hai kyunke us ki tahein ek doosre ko zyada rokti hain; us ki viscosity zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Hilaye hue beaker mein beech (centre) ka liquid sab se der tak kyun ghoomta rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Deewar wali tah deewar ki wajah se foran ruk jati hai; har agli andar wali tah apne bahar wali aahista tah se ragar ki wajah se thori aahista hoti hai. Beech wala hissa deewar se sab se door hai, is liye us par yeh rukawat sab se aakhir mein aur sab se kam pohanchti hai.

items: Viscosity: liquid ke behne ke khilaf rukawat, saath wali tahon ke darmiyan friction; deewar wali tah pehle rukti hai, beech wali aakhir mein.
Units: kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ (SI), poise P (CGS).
